name: Nomad (Oracle Mystery)
body:
Nomads lead a rugged and adaptable life in regions with few resources. They traverse vast stretches of land, following seasonal migration patterns in search of better grazing opportunities, flowering plants, and water availability while adapting to harsh living conditions. Nomads live in traditional tents or other makeshift shelters that are easily assembled and disassembled for mobility. Nomadic communities are tightlyknit, with extended families working together for survival. Possessing a deep knowledge of local flora and fauna, nomads endeavor to become one with nature, passing on the necessary lore to survive through oral traditions so future generations can continue to thrive.

Class Skills: An oracle with the nomad mystery adds Knowledge (nature), Perception, Ride, and Survival to her list of class skills.

Bonus Spells: endure elements (2nd), ropeweave (4th), longstrider, greater (6th), ward of the season (8th), life bubble (10th), find the path (12th), fairy ring retreat (14th), wandering weather (16th), gate (18th).

Revelations: An oracle with the nomad mystery can choose from any of the following revelations.

Calloused Skin (Ex)

Constant exposure to the elements has toughened your skin.

Your natural armor bonus increases by +2 (to 12 instead of 10). At 11th level, this bonus increases by +2 to 14.

Homemade Shelter (Sp)

Once per day, as a spell-like ability, you can cast web shelter. At 6th level, you can substitute tiny hut for web shelter. At 8th level, you can substitute grove of respite for web shelter. At 10th level, you can substitute sturdy tree fort for web shelter. You must be at least 3rd level to select this revelation.

No One’s Land (Su)

When a creature is about to make a melee attack against you, you can use an immediate action to teleport to a deserted, uninhabited location. You end up in a demiplane as though you had cast create demiplane, lesser. No one else can inhabit this place with you. At the start of your next turn, you are automatically returned to a square of your choice within 30 feet of your previous location when you used this ability (no action required). You can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day at 19th level. You must be at least 11th level to select this revelation.

Nomad’s Stride (Ex)

Your base land speed increases by +10 feet.

On The Move (Ex)

You learn one language of your choice when you select this revelation. Afterwards, every time you invest a rank in Linguistics, you learn two languages instead of one.

Traveling Companion (Sp)

Once per day, you can cast mount as a spell-like ability (with a duration of 24 hours). At 11th level, you can choose to cast mount, communal in place of mount (but its duration is the same as the spell).

Traveling Magic (Sp)

At any of the indicated levels, you can choose to substitute the traveling magic spell listed below for a bonus nomad spell listed above.

For example, when you get your bonus spell at 2nd level, you could choose to take air step instead of ropeweave. Likewise, when you get your bonus spell at 4th level, you could choose to substitute freedom of movement for ward of the season or you could keep ward of the season, whichever you prefer, and so on at each bonus spell level.

Traveling Magic Spells: feather step (2nd), air step (4th), feather step, mass (6th), freedom of movement(8th), tree stride (10th), eagle aerie (12th), ethereal jaunt (14th), teleport, greater (16th), etherealness (18th)

Tribal Survival (Ex)

You gain a bonus teamwork feat of your choice. You must meet the prerequisites for this feat. Each day when you prepare yourself to cast spells, you can designate a number of individuals equal to your Charisma modifier as tribe members. For the next 24 hours, these tribe members are treated as if they possessed the same teamwork feat for the purpose of determining whether you receive a bonus from your teamwork feat.

Ultimate Forager (Ex and Sp)

You gain the bonus feat Skill Focus (Survival). At 7th level, you can cast allfood once per day as a spell-like ability.

Wary (Ex)

You are always on the lookout for danger; you gain a +2 bonus on Perception checks and Initiative rolls. This bonus increases to +4 at 11th level.

Final Revelation

Upon reaching 20th level, you become the ultimate traveler.

Difficult terrain never imposes penalties to your movement, whether it is natural or magical in nature. Your land speed increases by +10 feet, and you gain a climb and swim speed equal to your land speed.

Furthermore, you can communicate with any creature that has a language, as though you are constantly under the effects of the tongues spell.

Lost Atlanteans, Copyright 2024, Bloodstone Press; author Beth Jones
